extracted.name: The Best Vegetable Salad
extracted.description: This vegetable salad uses a variety of fresh and colorful vegetables tossed in a pomegranate and herb dressing for a refreshingly tasty side dish.
ingredient_lines: 5 romaine lettuce leaves, torn into bite size pieces
instruction_lines: Place lettuce, radishes, tomatoes, green onion, jicama, cucumber, and bell pepper in a large salad bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, pomegranate juice, water, garlic, dill, basil, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl. Drizzle dressing over the salad just before serving.
